What Amala does: Read the task queue, check yesterday's unfinished work, verify tool availability and available disk space.
Completion check: Blockers and priorities recorded; no secrets in logs.

What Amala does: Continue the highest-priority approved Multimax/project task; make a small, testable change.
Completion check: Tests or a clear blocker note recorded.

What Amala does: Run available checks, summarize progress, save work, and update the task tracker.
Completion check: Work is saved; unfinished tasks have next steps.

What Amala does: Research AI tools/tech hacks topics, assess usefulness and originality, shortlist topics, and choose one suitable video.
Tools: Groq API (free quota), browser/search tools, YouTube search, Google Trends if accessible
Completion check: Topic is useful, demonstrable, current enough, and not copied.

What Amala does: Write the hook, concise script, scene-by-scene storyboard, on-screen text, and call to action.
Completion check: Claims checked; script is original and matches the planned duration.

Tools: Piper TTS, Python, Whisper only if needed
Completion check: Audio plays; pronunciation and captions checked.

What Amala does: Create original visuals, title cards, simple diagrams, and thumbnail draft; collect only assets with permitted usage.
Completion check: All assets are original or have documented usage rights.

What Amala does: Pause the workflow; preserve progress and avoid launching a long task that could block the next stage.
Completion check: State saved; no process left stuck unintentionally.

Completion check: Video renders and has correct aspect ratio, duration, audio, and captions.

What Amala does: Watch/listen to the rendered video, verify facts, check clipping, spelling, audio levels, and copyright/asset notes; fix obvious defects.
Completion check: No known critical defect; otherwise mark blocked and do not upload.

What Amala does: Prepare title, description, hashtags where useful, thumbnail, audience settings, and a draft upload record.
Tools: Groq, YouTube Studio or YouTube Data API if authorized
Completion check: Metadata is accurate; publishing permission status is recorded.

Tools: YouTube Studio / authorized YouTube Data API
Expected file / evidence: upload-log.csv; confirmed URL/ID if upload succeeds

What Amala does: For existing videos, review available performance data; otherwise record baseline and choose a follow-up topic based on evidence.
Completion check: No invented metrics; distinguish missing data from zero.

What Amala does: Update the README, daily changelog, topic/script metadata, and workflow docs. Keep large media out of Git unless intentionally approved.
Tools: Git, GitHub CLI or authenticated Git workflow
Completion check: No API keys, passwords, personal data, or unnecessary large media included.

What Amala does: Run checks, inspect Git diff, commit and push only to the approved repository/branch, then summarize completed work and blockers.
